{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the latest (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
df_control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients and responses
total_patients = len(df_control_moderate)
responded_count = df_control_moderate['responded'].sum()

print(f'Total CONTROL-arm, MODERATE patients: {total_patients}')
print(f'Responded: {responded_count}')

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = responded_count / total_patients
fraction_responded"}
